newsitem.title: THAILAND: China buys another Thai raw sugar cargo for March.
newsitem.headline: China buys another Thai raw sugar cargo for March.

text.p: China bought another cargo of Thai raw sugar for prompt shipment, trade sources said on Tuesday.
Japanese trade house Mitsui was one of the suppliers. The vessel Feng Guang is scheduled to arrive later this month for loading.
Traders said they expected the shipment of two more cargoes within this month.

"The market is quite happy with China's presence. It's not that they are bombarding the market with their purchases or anything, at least not yet...but many mills are eager to get rid of their huge raw stocks," said one trader.
China has bought about four cagoes of Thai sugar since February.
